sections.skill: Calculate adjusted gross income and taxable income using adjustments and deductions

questions.prompt: For this scenario, assume the standard deduction for a single filer is $15,000. Omar's total income is $55,000, with no adjustments. What is his taxable income?
questions.intro: Taxable income is the income that tax rates are applied to. Steps: total (gross) income − adjustments (such as some retirement or student loan interest deductions) = adjusted gross income (AGI); AGI − deductions (the standard deduction or itemized deductions) = taxable income.
questions.topic: From gross income to taxable income
sources: IRS (Federal income tax rates and brackets): The U.S. uses progressive marginal brackets; bracket thresholds and the standard deduction change every year. This course uses stated hypothetical amounts. (https://www.irs.gov/filing/federal-income-tax-rates-and-brackets)
